language.name: Ogbia
language.description: Ogbia is a Central Delta language spoken in Bayelsa State, Nigeria.

vocabulary.note: ogho appears as 'to buy' in examples

vocabulary.englishTranslation: to do farmwork / to enter / to tell (context-dependent)
to bail water from a canoe
in, from, at, to, towards, etc.
object marker (prefixed to nouns/pronouns used as objects)
negative imperative prefix / question particle / intensifier / conjunction (highly homophonous — meaning depends on context)
just (recent past marker) / each (as quantifier, written separately)
definite article / determiner 'the' (suffix, invariable) — also marks relativisation ('who/which') when suffixed to a verb

vocabulary.ogbiaWord: Bhiné ka ạbhár ka ạbhár mạlugburu ísísi!

vocabulary.englishTranslation: On which day did you come?
The rain is likely to fall.
It's been long since they ate.
You are who? = Who are you?

culturalContent.title: Ogbia Traditional Attire & Noun Classes
culturalContent.description: Learn about the traditional culture and noun class systems of Ogbia.
culturalContent.details: Ogbia culture features distinctive vowel-prefixed noun classes and vibrant festivals in Bayelsa State.

culturalContent.title: Ogbia River Heritage
culturalContent.description: The historical and economic significance of the Kolo Creek and rivers to the Ogbia people.
culturalContent.details: Rivers and creeks form the lifeline of fishing, transportation, and folklore in Ogbia land.

proverbs.literalTranslation: Ogbia proverb: Word of the land.
proverbs.meaning: Reflects the wisdom and cultural heritage of Ogbia speakers.
